title: Compare lower and decayed entropy with constant0.01
doing: Propose constant0.01, constant0.001 and a preregistered0.01-to0.001 decay at a locked recipe, with two training seeds per arm. Match the LR schedule and exposure, log entropy, KL, advantage and switch rates, and save entropy schedule state. No launch authorized.
expected: Lower or decayed entropy may reduce harmful action switching, or reduce useful exploration and worsen the weak tail. A lower switch rate does not by itself establish better action quality.
